summary: Metal-frame Tour de feu near 12 rue Comeau in Maniwaki, dated about 1945; no source says if it stands, but a rebuilt tower can be climbed at a local centre.

Register places the tower near 12 rue Comeau

notes_for_editor: The register (fiche 173366) is the only source for the 1945 tower itself: construction 'vers 1945', metal frame, rectangular plan, a stair listed among its projecting parts, near 12 rue Comeau. It gives no status, agency, staffing or access. The register's coordinates match the record. No source read says whether the 1945 structure still stands. The city gives the interpretation centre's address as 186 rue Principale sud (Château Logue), while La Vitrine gives 8 rue Comeau; the city's rebuilt tower and La Vitrine's new 80-ft tower may be the same structure, and the sources do not say it is the 1945 tower. Facebook heritage-photo posts about 'Tour à feu, rue Comeau' appeared in search results but would not load, so they are not used; a human could check their captions for the tower's fate. The register's listing year is not stated, so no listing event was added.
